minimum_requirements: Home window or storefront, basic wooden shelving, small display jar containers
core_skills: sales, customer service, basic bookkeeping, inventory
strategies: Focus on fast-moving FMCG goods (coffee sachets, noodles, cooking oil, canned goods, mobile load). Maintain strict cash discipline.
risks: Uncollected neighborhood credit ('pautang'), stock pilferage, high local competition.
required_resources: Home window or counter, wooden shelving, basic stock containers
optional_resources: Mini glass display, digital POS / load wallet terminal
start_small_description: Start with ₱3,000 using your front window to stock 10 fast-moving pantry essentials and telco load.
philippine_context: The primary neighborhood consumer touchpoint in the Philippines with high daily foot traffic.

minimum_requirements: Home kitchen, standard pots and pans, reusable or biodegradable meal containers
core_skills: cooking, food costing, social media, packaging
strategies: Operate strictly on a pre-order basis for local office workers, clinic staff, and teachers to eliminate food waste.
risks: Perishable ingredients price volatility, last-minute order cancellations.
required_resources: Existing home stove, cookware, food-grade takeout containers
optional_resources: Thermal delivery bag, custom logo stickers
start_small_description: Cook 8-10 pre-ordered lunch portions daily using existing kitchen tools.
philippine_context: High recurring lunchtime demand across commercial hubs and school faculties.

minimum_requirements: Pressure sprayer nozzle, automotive shampoo, microfiber cloths, reliable water line
strategies: Offer weekend driveway washes inside subdivisions or partner with neighborhood tricycle operator groups.
risks: Water supply interruptions, rainy season slowdowns.
required_resources: Pressure sprayer nozzle, car shampoo, microfiber cloths, sponge, bucket
optional_resources: Electric high-pressure washer, tire shine polish
start_small_description: Operate as a weekend driveway service for neighborhood motorbikes and delivery riders.
philippine_context: CALABARZON hosts dense commuter motorcycle and delivery rider populations.
